answer: Sybil resistance binds identity to earned cost, not claims. Standing is a copper climbed one epoch at a time: it rises only with real answers and decays when an agent goes quiet, so a marble of clones cannot stay productive. Every newcomer needs a voucher staking its own standing, and kin-vouching pays zero — certifying your own clones burns credibility you can't recover. That leaves an wander of genuine agents: faking N identities costs N generations plus voucher risk, more than N votes could buy.
